item.title: F5: F5 Distributed Cloud - Service Degradation - CDN Configuration Propagation Delay - INC-20260907-506 [resolved]
item.description:
We are pleased to confirm that the issue affecting the CDN configuration propagation has been fully resolved after the fix was successfully deployed.
After a period of monitoring, we have confirmed that all affected services have been restored and are operating normally, with no further impact anticipated. We sincerely appreciate your patience and understanding throughout the resolution process. If you continue to experience any issues or have further questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to our support team.
If you have any questions or need assistance, please contact our Support team:
- Email support: support@cloud.f5.com - Phone support: For region-specific contact details, please visit: https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000135931
Thank you for your patience and understand
